title: Clawd X Digest
summary: Agent Loops & Autocomplete: Anthropic's team showcases agent loops building full apps in 40 minutes, while developers debate Andrej Karpathy's thesis that natural language prompts are inefficient compared to cursor-guided autocomplete.
Grok Video & Zhipu Growth: xAI announces Grok Imagine Video 1.5 featuring enhanced realism and physics, as commentators highlight the massive valuation growth of Chinese AI startup Zhipu.
European Competitiveness: Viral discussions analyze the economic and competitive standing of Europe, highlighting issues in regional energy and productivity policies.

Japan's Pedestrian Safety: Public debates grow around the 'Butsukari' phenomenon in Japan where men deliberately bump into vulnerable pedestrians, highlighted by a strongman's selective shoulder check demo.

Sports Injuries & Regulatory Fines: German defender Nico Schlotterbeck is sidelined for 8 weeks ending his World Cup, and pop star Jane Zhang is fined 760k RMB for performing unauthorized acapella songs.

items.title: Anatoli Kopadze (@AnatoliKopadze)
items.body: Anthropic engineers demonstrate building a full app in 40 minutes using Claude Code running in a multi-agent loop, proving that developer loops are becoming more critical than standalone model intelligence.

items.title: Vincent (@VincentLogic)
items.body: Andrej Karpathy argues that natural language prompt programming is inefficient, advocating instead for high-density cursor autocomplete where developers act as architects guiding the autocomplete loop.

items.title: xAI (@xai)
items.body: xAI releases Grok Imagine Video 1.5, their new image-to-video model featuring sharper realism, better physics, and faster generation times.

items.title: Matt Graham (@Matt_Graham_)
items.body: A viral critique warns about the risks of prompt-driven 'vibe coding', noting that continuous AI generation without structural planning creates long-term code maintainability issues.

items.title: 0xAA (@0xAA_Science)
items.body: Commentators highlight the massive return on investment for early backers of Chinese AI pioneer Zhipu, noting its valuation has grown 21x since January.

items.title: 王长富 (@wangchangfu88)
items.body: A popular demonstration showcases using Codex to automatically sketch complex architectural and logic flowcharts from developer commands.

items.title: Isaac (@isaacrrr7)
items.body: A viral 19-second video outlining Europe's current economic and energy crisis goes viral, explaining competitiveness issues across the EU.

items.title: Bryan E. Leib (@BryanLeibFL)
items.body: Criticism mounts over the US VP's diplomatic meetings in Qatar following interactions surrounding the Iranian Foreign Minister's delegation.

items.title: Monty Bennett (@MontyBennett)
items.body: Monty Bennett pushes back on taxing billionaires by highlighting that the US federal government spends $20 billion daily, framing the national deficit as a spending crisis.

items.title: 作家崔成浩 (@cuichenghao)
items.body: A highway toll discrepancy report goes viral after a driver was charged 132 RMB using the automated ETC system, while their friend paying manually was only charged 88 RMB.

items.title: Barack Obama (@BarackObama)

items.body: Social media debates ignite over Japan's 'Butsukari' men who intentionally bump into women and kids, contrasted with a strongman standing his ground.

items.title: Bayern & Germany (@iMiaSanMia)
